label: Full-shift depth two
title: Full-shift depth at most two is decided by sparse reachability; the periodic gap recurs one level up, and some all-ring depth-one rules have full-shift depth at least three
kind: Exact full-shift certificate of refinement depth at most two for eight observations, with the rings-3-to-14 depth gap
summary: Whether two steps of observed history make an observation autonomous on the full shift is decided for every rule by reachability in a sparse 4096-vertex pair graph, with no matrix powers. Both bets failed: 24 of the fourteenth unit's 54 gap rules have full-shift depth at least three, not two, and the rings-3-to-14 depth-two gap is nonempty for seven of the eight observations, including 4, 32, 90 and 150, which had no depth-one gap. All 54 earlier gap witnesses became explicit eventually periodic configuration pairs.
takeaway: The gap between periodic configurations and the full shift recurs at depth two and can be deep: a rule can need one step of history on every ring and at least three on the line.
